Timing (Main).short: Primary ignition advance table used under normal high-load operation.
Timing (Main).long: This family controls the base spark target before knock, temperature, and compensations are applied. Higher values generally increase torque until you hit knock or thermal limits.

Fuel Scalar.short: Global fuel mass scaling for the selected map.
Fuel Scalar.long: Use this to bias fueling richer or leaner across the entire map family before fine-tuning the individual main or spool fuel tables.

Boost Ceiling (Relative) (Gear x RPM).short: Gear-by-RPM relative boost ceiling used to limit boost request by operating condition.
Boost Ceiling (Relative) (Gear x RPM).long: This family acts as a safety and drivability limiter. It is often one of the first places to inspect when requested boost does not match the target or when a map is gear-limited.
